I will position one of our Siege Dreadnoughts above the city and erase it from the map. That will take the fight out of the locals. I guarantee it.|General Armitage Hux to Supreme Leader Kylo Ren|}} '''Spinnaker''' was a coastal [[city]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] that was inhabited by the [[human]] [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]. The city featured numerous buildings with [[Color|tan]] walls and green domed roofs. In [[34 ABY]], Naboo was [[Assault on Naboo (First Order)|occupied]] by the [[First Order]] under the direction of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], who also sought to inspire rebellion on Naboo to challenge its people into evolving. A disguised Ren attacked a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] patrol in Spinnaker and led a resistance movement from an underground shelter, resulting in multiple attacks against First Order forces. Spinnaker ultimately became the primary source of resistance, giving cause for the First Order [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]]'s plan to obliterate it with a [[Unidentified Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]]. Ren impelled the resistance movement to attack the [[Siege Dreadnought]] with any available [[starship]]s; they launched their assault as the Dreadnought took position above Spinnaker. The fighters were able to destroy one of the vessel's [[autocannon]]s, and, just as the remaining cannon was about to fire on the city, Ren called off the assault on Naboo following persuasion by his [[cyborg]] guide [[Vaneé]]. ==Description== Spinnaker was a major''[[Nexus of Power]]'' coastal [[city]] on on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. It was inhabited by the [[human]] [[Naboo (people)|Naboo people]] and featured numerous buildings constructed along the coastline with [[Color|tan]] walls and domed green roofs, the latter a feature of [[Naboo classical architecture]].{{BuildFalconCite|24|Guide to the Galaxy}} [[Tree]]s also grew within many of the city's streets. Points of interest within the city included a courtyard, at least one bridge over a [[Water|river]], scrapyards filled with [[starship]]s, and an underground shelter. ==History== ===Invasion=== {{Quote|Orders, sir?''"
"''Destroy all resistance. Any local who fights back is to be terminated with extreme prejudice.|A First Order sergeant and an officer, in a courtyard in Spinnaker|}} [[File:SpinnakerPlaza-LegacyOfVader5.png|thumb|right|300px|First Order forces attempted to occupy Spinnaker.]] In [[34 ABY]],The events of [[Legacy of Vader 5|''Legacy of Vader'' 5]] take place in [[34 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:LegacyOfVaderDate|here]]. [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] of the [[Fascism|fascist]] [[First Order]] declared himself [[king]] and launched an [[Assault on Naboo (First Order)|assault on Naboo]], the [[homeworld]] of his [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|grandmother]], as part of his campaign to conquer [[the galaxy]]. First Order [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s and [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport]]s descended into Spinnaker, observed by an elder who identified them as heralds of an invasion to a younger peer. In [[orbit]] aboard their [[flagship]], the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]][[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] ''[[Finalizer]]'', Ren and [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] viewed a [[hologram]] of the starships above Spinnaker while they discussed the purpose of the invasion and the Naboo's lack of resistance. Ren elected to disguise himself and pose as a resistance fighter against the First Order, hoping to challenge the people of Naboo to evolve beyond their placid nature. Within a courtyard in Spinnaker, a group of [[First Order stormtrooper]]s and an [[Urban Assault Triped Transport]] (UA-TT) gathered under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of an [[Unidentified First Order officer (Naboo)|officer]], observed by a crowd of Naboo. A [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper sergeant (Naboo)|stormtrooper sergeant]] requested orders, to which the officer identified that they would follow the standard playbook: resistance would be terminated with extreme prejudice and local leaders would be identified and executed if they refused orders. Before enacting the orders, the sergeant was shot in the head by the incognito Ren, who used his [[Force power]]s to first fight the stormtroopers in [[Unarmed combat|hand to hand combat]] and then to [[Telekinesis|telekinetically]] control the UA-TT. He used the [[walker]] to fire on the remaining stormtroopers and commandeered a [[landspeeder]] with which he killed the [[First Order officer]]. The stunned Naboo questioned who the anonymous [[Soldier|warrior]] was and how he had overpowered the stormtroopers. ===Resistance=== {{Quote|For occupiers, there is no safe ground. Every street can become a killbox. Every bridge, an easily destroyed choke point. Every citizen, a warrior.|Kylo Ren, covertly rallying the Naboo to attack the First Order|}} Meeting with a crowd in an underground shelter, Ren encouraged them by claiming the First Order was overconfident and could be defeated while dismissing reports that they had been defeated at the [[Battle of Crait]] at the hands of galactic [[Resistance]] figures [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Several of the citizens wondered if Ren would even be a damaging leader for Naboo, given that they had endured the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]] and survived. The undercover Ren insisted the Supreme Leader would take everything from them. He continued to rally the Naboo to resistance, teaching them tactics formerly used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the Empire. [[File:SpinnakerBridge-LegacyOfVader5.png|thumb|left|350px|Spinnaker became a hotspot of resistance against the First Order.]] Spinnaker's citizens engaged in numerous acts of defiance, including an ambush of a stormtrooper patrol, an explosion of a UA-TT on a bridge, and the destruction of an [[All Terrain MegaCaliber Six]] using [[Gungan catapult]]s, which Ren personally oversaw. Spinnaker became the primary source of rebel activity. Consequently, when Ren next contacted Hux, the general revealed that his plan was to send a [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] to annihilate the city, to which the Supreme Leader approved. Meeting again with insurgents underground, Ren showed them a hologram of the [[Unidentified Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|Siege Dreadnought]] above the city and announced that his plan was for the Naboo to use the available starships they had to take it down. A [[Unidentified Spinnaker insurgent|citizen]] expressed skepticism, believing they needed to surrender before the First Order destroyed Spinnaker and millions of Naboo's population. Ren countered by arguing that the First Order needed to send a message following the Naboo's defiance and that further attacks against them was the only way to save the planet. The citizens of Naboo prepared every vessel they could find, including [[Standard decade|decades]]-old [[X-wing starfighter]]s, [[N-1 starfighter]]s, and [[Ugly|uglies]] made from various ship parts. ===Battle for Naboo=== {{Quote|But hold off on the bombardment until we've dealt with them. Let the people below watch their pathetic act of defiance burn.|General Hux, speaking of the Naboo starfighters during their attack|}} [[File:BattleForSpinnaker-LegacyOfVader5.png|thumb|right|300px|Naboo's fighters fly against the First Order's Dreadnought above Spinnaker.]] In the [[Siege Dreadnought]] above Spinnaker, General Hux gave the order to begin the bombardment when the incoming fighters were detected. Hux subsequently changed his order to delay the strike on Spinnaker until the Dreadnought's [[gunner]]s had finished off the [[starfighter]]s, intending to crush the hopes of the civilians watching in the city. Ren observed the events from a hologram in the bunker and gave the signal for the insurgents to attack, after which he was interrupted by [[Vaneé]], the [[cyborg]] who had been guiding the Supreme Leader in following the legacy of his grandfather, [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. As the Dreadnought shot down the Naboo's ships, many of them flew toward the ship's underside, where it was less defended; Hux called for TIE Fighter reinforcements in response. In the shelter, Vaneé challenged Ren's motivation, believing his attacks against his own forces were motivated by self-hatred. Ren reacted angrily, damaging the cyborg's body telekinetically and demanding the power Vaneé had promised him. Meanwhile, the Naboo starfighters were able to destroy one of the Dreadnought's two [[autocannon]]s before the arrival of the First Order's TIE Fighters. Vaneé promised Ren that he would give him the contents of a vault within [[Fortress Vader]] on the planet''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' [[Mustafar]] once Ren had become worthy of Vader's legacy and let go of his need to destroy the past. Just as the Dreadnought was preparing its autocannon to fire on Spinnaker, Ren gave Hux the order to cease the attack and return to their [[First Order Navy|fleet]], angering the general, who nonetheless complied. A gathering of Naboo joined Ren underground to celebrate their victory and thank him; however, the Supreme Leader murdered all those present. As he left the shelter, Ren demanded that Vaneé find him an enemy who would be worth defeating, and Vaneé acknowledged to himself that he had a [[Grandea|perfect candidate]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Spinnaker_main_new.png|thumb|right|300px|Spinnaker as it appeared in the Legends video game ''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'']] Spinnaker was first [[canon]]ically mentioned in the [[2016]] sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', published as part of [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] product line. The city later made its first full appearance in [[2025]] within the [[Legacy of Vader 5|fifth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of Vader]]'', written by [[Charles Soule]] and illustrated by [[Stefano Raffaele]]. Illustrations featuring Spinnaker were first published in online previews on [[June 20]], 2025,{{WebCite|url=https://aiptcomics.com|text=Marvel Preview: Star Wars: Legacy of Vader #5|work=[https://aiptcomics.com/ All in Poor Taste]|archivedate=20250729112412}} prior to the comic's release date on [[June 25]].{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/119566/star_wars_legacy_of_vader_2025_5|text=Star Wars: Legacy of Vader (2025) #5}} In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] was created for the the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' which was released on [[November 11]], [[2001]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamespot.com/games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds|archivedate=20201203224932}} Before its appearance in the game, the city was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]], which was authored by [[Steven L. Kent]][[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]] and published on [[November 7]] of the same year.{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Spinnaker}} *[[Legacy of Vader 5|''Legacy of Vader'' 5]] {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Nexus of Power]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Cities]] [[Category:Naboo locations]]
